events.event: Board of Fellows meeting where a decision was made regarding Knickerbocker and Goldenson's future at the college.
events.source: No notes of the meeting survive
events.quote: In a Board of Fellows meeting held April 14, 1936, five members—Rice, Albers, Dreier, Mangold and Mary Beaman (the Student Moderator)—voted to transmit to Knickerbocker (and also to Goldenson) the statement that “on the basis of this year” the Board was “quite pessimistic about the possibility of [their] . . . developing into the kind of teacher[s] we want here permanently.”

events.event: The faculty decided to continue the college for the fall term.

events.event: A series of faculty and Board meetings took place where Rondthaler resigned as treasurer and Dreier announced he might leave the college.
events.quote: In a series of faculty and Board meetings at the end of August 1948 (just before the Levis left for Europe), Rondthaler, Levi’s chief ally, resigned as treasurer, and Dreier, who had temporarily taken over as rector in June after Levi’s resignation, announced that he was no longer willing to bear that responsibility—and even suggested that he, too, might want to leave the college for good.

events.event: Formal amendments introduced into the bylaws for student rights.
events.quote: By spring of the first year, formal amendments had been introduced into the bylaws entitling any member of the college to inspect all records of the corporation

events.event: Each summer during the thirties, the Blue Ridge Assembly of the Protestant Church repossessed its buildings.
events.quote: Each summer during the thirties, when the Blue Ridge Assembly of the Protestant Church repossessed its buildings for an orgy of conferences, a few Black Mountain people were allowed to remain on the premises to oversee interim college affairs.

events.event: The farm at Black Mountain College produces 60 percent of the community’s food.
events.quote: The farm helped in that regard—at one point it produced 60 percent of the community’s food.

events.event: The town went dry and Stephen Forbes financed a new café outside town limits.
events.quote: When, in the mid-thirties, the town went dry, Roy, the bar’s owner, somehow found out that one of the college students, Stephen Forbes, was from a wealthy New England clan, and he took Forbes aside one day and proposed that together they build a small café just outside the town limits.

events.event: Aristide Mavridis visited Black Mountain College.
events.quote: One such was Aristide Mavridis, whose sister was married to Cimon Diamantopoulos, the Greek ambassador to the United States in the early forties

events.event: Wallen's first suggestions for change in the community regarding the work program.
events.quote: His first suggestions for change in the community were in regard to a subject dissected so often in the past—the work program.

events.event: A group of students discussed community problems at the Wallens’ home.
events.quote: The idea first came up when a group of students, sitting around the Wallens’ home after dinner one night, started to discuss community problems in general.

events.event: Petition circulated for a community meeting to discuss the work program.
events.quote: They then circulated a petition calling for a community meeting to discuss the list; Wallen collected faculty signatures and the students circularized other students.

events.event: Wallen proposed a new format for the community meeting on the work program.
events.quote: As a pilot demonstration, Wallen proposed to the faculty that the pending community meeting on the work program be organized in a new way.

events.event: Community meeting held with Wallen's new format.
events.quote: His diplomacy paid off. The meeting proved a great success.

events.event: Second community meeting held to discuss the work program suggestions.
events.quote: A few weeks later, his committee did issue a lengthy summary of the suggestions made by the subgroups, and a second community meeting was held to discuss it.

events.event: Wallen's committee issued a summary of suggestions from the subgroups.
events.quote: A few weeks later, his committee did issue a lengthy summary of the suggestions made by the subgroups.
